reviews.title: So Good, So Far
reviews.comment: It certainly can happen to any RAM memory kit, but it happen to be G.Skill for me. It barely made it a year. Short story for me was my RAM was failing. Game_Ship exe was the first sign in WZ3. Tried most of the "fixes" I found on line, like turning off XMP, nothing worked and it kept getting worse. Second clue was Chrome windows would close unexpectedly. So, I decided to do a clean reinstall of Windows and everything else. This turned in to one frustrating event. Blue Screens of Death with different trouble codes constantly. Never got Windows fully installed after many, many tries. One code popped up a few times though, Memory_Stop, or something to that affect. Hmm. Decided to buy new RAM. Installed it and everything went like butter, start to finish. My computer is running great, with XMP on, and COD/WZ3 with all the bells and whistles running, perfect. Ultimately, I bought this Kingston Fury, 32GB C18 3600.
reviews.author: Later2u

reviews.title: Great RAM!
reviews.comment: The ram works great in the computer. It wasn't flashy with RGB so that's one reason I got it. Plus Kingston has a good rep and I have heard they have great customer service. I don't know personally because I have never had to deal with them. The just have great products.

reviews.comment: Works as intended and and very stable at listed speed.

reviews.title: You have to up the voltage
reviews.comment: Great ram but you have to increase the voltage in the bios to 1.35 to get the normal benefit. Motherboard is set to 1.2 by default and it make it unstable. Up it and it feels like a new computer.
reviews.author: Juan
